subject: ai-infrastructure-constraint-measurements-r1

CN:accelerator-logic.reason: Provider statement establishes excess demand direction but no independent same-unit demand quantity exists for China frontier-equivalent accelerators.
CN:accelerator-logic.resolutionRequirement: Obtain an independent same-scope/time demand or committed-order measure in accelerator units, H100e-equivalent useful compute, or another explicitly bridged unit.

CN:hbm.reason: 240k domestic-supported units and 320k total modeled 950DT units share the same supply-constrained production model; dividing them would measure modeled source mix, not HBM supply headroom against independent demand.
CN:hbm.resolutionRequirement: Acquire an independent same-unit requirement: contracted/customer 950DT demand by memory configuration or China-wide HBM GB demand derived from independently observed accelerator orders/BOMs, with the same 2026 delivery basis.

US:transformer-switchgear.reason: Lead time demonstrates schedule pressure but does not identify annual qualified transformer MVA flow versus committed/project MVA requirement in one voltage/specification class.
US:transformer-switchgear.resolutionRequirement: Obtain annual qualified production/import flow and order backlog in matched MVA/voltage classes for AI/data-center substations, with delivery dates.

US:grid-interconnection-transmission.reason: The 2,060GW Berkeley Lab figure is generation/storage interconnection while the bottleneck question is load connection and transmission deliverability. ERCOT now provides a load-side request/maturity funnel, but it remains regional and requested/qualified status is not the same as national deliverable grid capacity.
US:grid-interconnection-transmission.resolutionRequirement: Build region-matched funnels from requested MW → verified/studied/approved MW → contracted/energized MW → observed peak load and compare them with region-specific firm supply/transmission capability; aggregate nationally only after compatible ISO/RTO coverage exists.

methodResult.reason: No current P0 pair yet satisfies same unit/scope/time plus independent requirement denominator. Scarcity direction remains usable without manufacturing pseudo-precision.

nonClaims: No numerical China HBM headroom ratio is admitted from 240k domestic-supported versus 320k total modeled 950DT units because the requirement denominator is endogenous to the same supply model.
Huawei excess-demand statements establish direction but not a same-unit numerical accelerator-demand denominator.
Transformer lead time is not transformer MVA headroom.
The Berkeley Lab generation/storage queue is not a large-load demand denominator.
ERCOT large-load request and maturity data are regional request/status observations, not national deliverable load headroom.
This acceptance does not prospectively validate the frontier heuristic, create an investment recommendation, infer owner risk appetite, or authorize financial effects.
